conditions: Configuration property under Developer Guide §5.1.1. Source spelling and platform-provided default are the documented behavior in this version.
limitations: User interface language, regional formatting, publisher translations and compatibility modes have separate scopes.

triggers: Publisher edition or documentation correction, article representation drift, or contrary language-boundary evidence.

statement: The 1C:Enterprise 8.3.27 Script variant property sets a Russian or English default for language forms assisted or generated by the platform. Both language forms remain available in source and changing the property leaves already entered language constructs spelled as before.
